chunks: My father - may God be pleased with him - narrated to us, saying: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us, from Yaqoob ibn Yazid, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Durost ibn Abi Mansoor, from a man, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The love for the world is the root of all sins.
ai.seo_question: What is the root of all sins according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In al-Khisal, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) assertion that love of the world (hubb al-dunya) is the 'head' or root of all sins, a concept deeply rooted in Shia ethical theology as the primary spiritual disease. This teaching aligns with the Quranic warning that worldly allurements distract believers from divine remembrance, emphasizing that inner attachment, rather than mere action, is the source of moral deviation. By identifying this root cause, the Imam provides a diagnostic tool for self-purification (tazkiyah), urging believers to cultivate detachment to prevent the proliferation of specific transgressions.
